import io
import json
import tarfile
import types
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from workstation_manager.domain.installation import parse_manifest
from workstation_manager.infrastructure.installation import installation_source


@pytest.fixture
def remote():
    namespace = {"__name__": "remote_install_test"}
    source = installation_source({}, "", "").split("\nlock_fd =")[0]
    exec(compile(source, "<install>", "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace


@pytest.fixture
def transaction(tmp_path, remote, install_manifest_data, monkeypatch):
    root = tmp_path / "zynthian"
    for name in (
        "config",
        "zynthian-sys/config",
        "zynthian-ui/zyngine",
        "zynthian-plugins/lv2",
        "zynthian-my-data/soundfonts/test/Piano",
    ):
        (root / name).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    source = root / "zynthian-ui/zyngine/zynthian_lv2.py"
    source.write_text(Path("tests/fixtures/engines/oram.txt").read_text())
    original_registry = {
        "OTHER": {
            "URL": "urn:other",
            "TYPE": "MIDI Synth",
            "ENABLED": True,
            "custom": {"preserve": [1, 2]},
        }
    }
    registry = root / "config/engine_config.json"
    registry.write_text(json.dumps(original_registry))
    (root / "zynthian-sys/config/engine_config.json").write_text("{}")
    instrument = root / "zynthian-my-data/soundfonts/test/Piano/existing.npno"
    instrument.write_bytes(b"preserve")
    install_manifest_data["instruments"] = {
        "base_path": "/zynthian/zynthian-my-data/soundfonts/test",
        "directories": ["Piano", "Strings"],
    }
    manifest = parse_manifest(
        install_manifest_data, "zynthian-workstation/test", "1.0.0"
    )
    spec = asdict(manifest)
    job = tmp_path / "job"
    job.mkdir()
    package = job / "package"
    header = bytearray(64)
    header[:6] = b"\x7fELF\x02\x01"
    header[16:18] = (3).to_bytes(2, "little")
    header[18:20] = (183).to_bytes(2, "little")
    with tarfile.open(package, "w:gz") as output:
        for name, data in [("manifest.ttl", b"fixture"), ("test.so", bytes(header))]:
            item = tarfile.TarInfo("Test.lv2/" + name)
            item.size = len(data)
            output.addfile(item, io.BytesIO(data))
    spec["sha256"] = remote["package_digest"](package)
    monkeypatch.setattr(remote["platform"], "machine", lambda: "aarch64")
    monkeypatch.setattr(remote["subprocess"], "run", Mock())
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        remote["shutil"], "disk_usage", lambda p: types.SimpleNamespace(free=10**12)
    )
    world = Mock()
    world.get_name.return_value = "Test"
    world.get_uri.return_value = spec["identity"]["plugin_uri"]
    world.get_all_plugins.return_value = [world]
    world.get_class.return_value = types.SimpleNamespace(
        get_label=lambda: "Instrument Plugin"
    )
    world.get_data_uris.return_value = []
    world.get_value.return_value = ["fixture description"]
    remote["MetadataWorld"] = Mock(return_value=world)
    remote["discover_presets"] = Mock(return_value=("Test", {}))

    def inventory(root):
        plugins = []
        if (root / "zynthian-plugins/lv2/Test.lv2").exists():
            plugins.append(
                dict(
                    uri=spec["identity"]["plugin_uri"],
                    bundle="Test.lv2",
                    package_version="1.0.0",
                    package_repository=manifest.identity.repository,
                )
            )
        records = json.loads(registry.read_text())
        return dict(
            plugins=plugins,
            registered_uris=[r["URL"] for r in records.values()],
            incomplete_bundles=[],
        )

    def run(**kwargs):
        return remote["install_transaction"](
            spec,
            package,
            job,
            root,
            kwargs.get("inspect", inventory),
            kwargs.get("restart", Mock()),
        )

    return types.SimpleNamespace(
        root=root,
        source=source,
        registry=registry,
        run=run,
        spec=spec,
        job=job,
        instrument=instrument,
        original_registry=original_registry,
        inventory=inventory,
    )


def test_install_register_enable_and_preserve(remote, transaction):
    result = transaction.run()
    assert result["success"], result
    registry = json.loads(transaction.registry.read_text())
    assert registry["OTHER"] == transaction.original_registry["OTHER"]
    assert registry["JV/Test"]["CAT"] == "Workstation"
    assert registry["JV/Test"]["TYPE"] == "MIDI Synth"
    assert registry["JV/Test"]["ENABLED"] is True
    assert transaction.instrument.read_bytes() == b"preserve"
    assert (transaction.instrument.parents[1] / "Strings").is_dir()
    assert transaction.source.read_text().count('"Workstation"') == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "point",
    [
        "architecture",
        "checksum",
        "existing_bundle",
        "existing_uri",
        "category_structure",
        "engine_profile",
        "extract",
        "uri",
        "version",
        "name",
        "registration",
        "presets",
        "restart",
        "final_inventory",
    ],
)
def test_failures_restore_previous_state(remote, transaction, point, monkeypatch):
    before_source = transaction.source.read_bytes()
    before_registry = transaction.registry.read_bytes()
    bundle = transaction.root / "zynthian-plugins/lv2/Test.lv2"
    restart = Mock()
    inventory = transaction.inventory
    if point == "architecture":
        monkeypatch.setattr(remote["platform"], "machine", lambda: "x86_64")
    elif point == "checksum":
        transaction.spec["sha256"] = "0" * 64
    elif point == "existing_bundle":
        bundle.mkdir()
        (bundle / "keep").write_bytes(b"keep")
    elif point == "existing_uri":
        document = json.loads(before_registry)
        document["existing"] = {"URL": transaction.spec["identity"]["plugin_uri"]}
        transaction.registry.write_text(json.dumps(document))
        before_registry = transaction.registry.read_bytes()
    elif point == "category_structure":
        transaction.source.write_text(
            before_source.decode().replace("Acoustic", "Unsupported")
        )
        before_source = transaction.source.read_bytes()
    elif point == "engine_profile":
        transaction.source.write_text(
            before_source.decode().replace(
                "def get_engines():", "def get_engines_unknown():"
            )
        )
        before_source = transaction.source.read_bytes()
    elif point == "extract":
        remote["extract_package"] = Mock(side_effect=ValueError("corrupt"))
    elif point in ("uri", "version", "final_inventory"):
        calls = []

        def inventory(root):
            result = transaction.inventory(root)
            calls.append(1)
            if bundle.exists():
                if point == "uri" or point == "final_inventory" and len(calls) == 4:
                    result["plugins"] = []
                elif point == "version":
                    result["plugins"][0]["package_version"] = "9.0.0"
            return result
    elif point == "name":
        remote["MetadataWorld"].return_value.get_name.return_value = "Other"
    elif point == "presets":
        remote["discover_presets"] = Mock(side_effect=ValueError("presets"))
    elif point == "registration":
        remote["configure"] = Mock(side_effect=ValueError("registration"))
    elif point == "restart":
        restart.side_effect = [TimeoutError("restart"), None]
    result = transaction.run(restart=restart, inspect=inventory)
    assert not result["success"], result
    assert not result["partial"], result
    assert transaction.source.read_bytes() == before_source
    assert transaction.registry.read_bytes() == before_registry
    assert transaction.instrument.read_bytes() == b"preserve"
    assert not (transaction.instrument.parents[1] / "Strings").exists()
    if point == "existing_bundle":
        assert (bundle / "keep").read_bytes() == b"keep"
    else:
        assert not bundle.exists()


def test_partial_rollback_preserves_recovery(remote, transaction):
    result = transaction.run(restart=Mock(side_effect=TimeoutError("service")))
    assert not result["success"]
    assert result["partial"]
    assert "Rollback parcial" in result["message"]
    assert transaction.job.exists()


def test_category_idempotent(remote):
    original = Path("tests/fixtures/engines/oram.txt").read_text()
    updated = remote["category_candidate"](original)
    assert remote["category_candidate"](updated) == updated
    assert updated.count('"Workstation"') == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("profile", ["oram", "vangelis"])
def test_audited_registration_profiles(remote, transaction, profile):
    transaction.source.write_text(
        Path(f"tests/fixtures/engines/{profile}.txt").read_text()
    )
    result = transaction.run()
    assert result["success"], result


def test_symlink_instruments_blocked(remote, transaction, tmp_path):
    destination = transaction.instrument.parents[1] / "Strings"
    destination.symlink_to(tmp_path, target_is_directory=True)
    result = transaction.run()
    assert not result["success"]
    assert not result["partial"]
    assert destination.is_symlink()


def test_concurrent_registry_writer_is_preserved(remote, transaction):
    def concurrent_restart():
        document = json.loads(transaction.registry.read_text())
        document["other-new"] = {"URL": "urn:another"}
        transaction.registry.write_text(json.dumps(document))
        raise RuntimeError("concurrent writer")

    result = transaction.run(restart=concurrent_restart)
    assert result["partial"]
    assert "other-new" in json.loads(transaction.registry.read_text())
    assert '"Workstation"' in transaction.source.read_text()


def test_existing_preset_cache_preserved(remote, transaction):
    cache = transaction.root / "config/jalv/presets_Test.json"
    cache.parent.mkdir()
    cache.write_bytes(b"user cache")
    result = transaction.run()
    assert not result["success"]
    assert not result["partial"], result
    assert cache.read_bytes() == b"user cache"


def test_service_polling_until_running(remote, monkeypatch):
    responses = [
        Mock(),
        Mock(stdout="ActiveState=activating\nSubState=start\nMainPID=0"),
        Mock(stdout="ActiveState=active\nSubState=running\nMainPID=123"),
    ]
    runner = Mock(side_effect=responses)
    monkeypatch.setattr(remote["subprocess"], "run", runner)
    monkeypatch.setattr(remote["time"], "sleep", Mock())
    remote["restart_interface"]()
    assert runner.call_count == 3


def test_service_poll_timeout(remote, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(remote["subprocess"], "run", Mock())
    monkeypatch.setattr(remote["time"], "monotonic", Mock(side_effect=[0, 91]))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Timeout"):
        remote["restart_interface"]()


def test_existing_category_is_unchanged(remote, transaction):
    transaction.source.write_text(
        remote["category_candidate"](transaction.source.read_text())
    )
    original = transaction.source.read_bytes()
    result = transaction.run()
    assert result["success"], result
    assert transaction.source.read_bytes() == original


def test_insufficient_space_is_read_only(remote, transaction, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        remote["shutil"],
        "disk_usage",
        lambda path: types.SimpleNamespace(free=1),
    )
    original = transaction.registry.read_bytes()
    result = transaction.run()
    assert not result["success"]
    assert not result["partial"]
    assert transaction.registry.read_bytes() == original


def test_new_instruments_not_removed_if_user_fills_directory(remote, transaction):
    created = transaction.instrument.parents[1] / "Strings"

    def fail():
        (created / "new-user-instrument").write_bytes(b"preserve")
        raise RuntimeError("service")

    result = transaction.run(restart=fail)
    assert not result["success"]
    assert result["partial"]
    assert (created / "new-user-instrument").read_bytes() == b"preserve"
    assert transaction.instrument.read_bytes() == b"preserve"


def test_unrelated_shared_directory_symlinks_do_not_block_install(remote, transaction):
    unrelated = transaction.root / "config/unrelated-link"
    unrelated.symlink_to("/etc/hostname")
    result = transaction.run()
    assert result["success"], result
    assert unrelated.is_symlink()


def test_transaction_target_ancestor_symlink_is_blocked(remote, transaction, tmp_path):
    plugins = transaction.root / "zynthian-plugins/lv2"
    plugins.rmdir()
    plugins.symlink_to(tmp_path, target_is_directory=True)
    result = transaction.run()
    assert not result["success"]
    assert not result["partial"]
    assert plugins.is_symlink()


@pytest.fixture
def nord_transaction(transaction, remote):
    root = transaction.root
    identity = transaction.spec["identity"]
    identity.update(
        repository="zynthian-workstation/nord",
        plugin_uri="urn:nord:instrument",
        bundle="Nord.lv2",
        display_name="Nord",
    )
    transaction.spec["integration_components"] = (
        "engine-registration",
        "dynamic-parameter-pages",
    )
    transaction.spec["instrument_base"] = "/zynthian/zynthian-my-data/soundfonts/nord"
    source = root / "zynthian-ui/zyngine"
    for filename, fixture in [
        ("zynthian_engine_jalv.py", "jalv.txt"),
        ("zynthian_processor.py", "processor.txt"),
    ]:
        (source / filename).write_bytes(
            (Path("tests/fixtures/nord-integration") / fixture).read_bytes()
        )
    transaction.ui_originals = {p: p.read_bytes() for p in source.glob("*.py")}
    existing = root / "zynthian-my-data/soundfonts/nord/Piano/existing.npno"
    existing.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    existing.write_bytes(b"preserve-nord")
    transaction.nord_instrument = existing
    entries = [("piano", "npno"), ("sample", "nsmp4"), ("pure", "pure")]
    catalog = "NORD-LIBRARY-2\0" + "".join(
        "\0".join((key, key, key, "Category", "Category", fmt, "-")) + "\0"
        for key, fmt in entries
    )
    layout = (
        "7\tgeneral\tGeneral\t0\tgain\t0\n"
        "6\tfilter\tFilter\t0\tcutoff\t0\n"
        "4\tfx\tFX\t0\treverb\t0\n"
    )
    header = bytearray(64)
    header[:6] = b"\x7fELF\x02\x01"
    header[16:18] = (3).to_bytes(2, "little")
    header[18:20] = (183).to_bytes(2, "little")
    package = transaction.job / "package"
    contents = {
        "manifest.ttl": b"fixture",
        "test.so": bytes(header),
        "catalog.nord": catalog.encode(),
        "tools/control-layout.tsv": layout.encode(),
        "tools/untrusted_payload.py": b'raise RuntimeError("must not run")\n',
    }
    with tarfile.open(package, "w:gz") as output:
        for name, data in contents.items():
            info = tarfile.TarInfo("Nord.lv2/" + name)
            info.size = len(data)
            output.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
    transaction.spec["sha256"] = remote["package_digest"](package)
    world = remote["MetadataWorld"].return_value
    world.get_name.return_value = "Nord"
    world.get_uri.return_value = identity["plugin_uri"]
    world.P = remote["C"].c_void_p
    symbols = ("gain", "cutoff", "reverb")

    def api(name, *args):
        if name == "lilv_plugin_get_num_ports":
            return lambda plugin: len(symbols)
        if name == "lilv_plugin_get_port_by_index":
            return lambda plugin, index: index
        if name == "lilv_port_get_symbol":
            return lambda plugin, port: symbols[port]
        raise AssertionError(name)

    world.api.side_effect = api
    world.string.side_effect = lambda symbol: symbol
    remote["discover_presets"].return_value = ("Nord", {})
    registry = transaction.registry

    def inventory(root):
        plugins = []
        if (root / "zynthian-plugins/lv2/Nord.lv2").exists():
            plugins.append(
                dict(
                    uri="urn:nord:instrument",
                    bundle="Nord.lv2",
                    package_version="1.0.0",
                    package_repository=identity["repository"],
                )
            )
        return dict(
            plugins=plugins,
            registered_uris=[
                v["URL"] for v in json.loads(registry.read_text()).values()
            ],
            incomplete_bundles=[],
        )

    def run(**kwargs):
        return remote["install_transaction"](
            transaction.spec,
            package,
            transaction.job,
            root,
            kwargs.get("inspect", inventory),
            kwargs.get("restart", Mock()),
        )

    transaction.run = run
    transaction.inventory = inventory
    transaction.nord_bundle = root / "zynthian-plugins/lv2/Nord.lv2"
    transaction.ui_directory = source
    return transaction


def assert_nord_restored(transaction):
    for path, original in transaction.ui_originals.items():
        assert path.read_bytes() == original
    assert not (transaction.ui_directory / "nord_host.py").exists()
    assert not (transaction.ui_directory / "nord_pages.py").exists()
    assert not transaction.nord_bundle.exists()
    assert transaction.nord_instrument.read_bytes() == b"preserve-nord"
    assert json.loads(transaction.registry.read_text()) == transaction.original_registry


def test_dynamic_pages_are_installed_and_verified_with_persistent_backups(
    remote, nord_transaction
):
    transaction = nord_transaction
    checkpoints = []

    def restart():
        assert (
            "from .nord_host import screens"
            in (transaction.ui_directory / "zynthian_processor.py").read_text()
        )
        assert (transaction.ui_directory / "nord_host.py").exists()
        checkpoints.append(True)

    result = transaction.run(restart=restart)
    assert result["success"], result
    assert checkpoints
    for name, expected in remote["NORD_UI_ASSETS"].items():
        assert (transaction.ui_directory / name).read_bytes() == expected
    assert (
        b"raise RuntimeError"
        in (transaction.nord_bundle / "tools/untrusted_payload.py").read_bytes()
    )
    assert transaction.nord_instrument.read_bytes() == b"preserve-nord"
    backup_root = transaction.root / "config/workstation-manager/integration-backups"
    manifests = list(backup_root.glob("*/manifest.json"))
    assert len(manifests) == 1
    records = json.loads(manifests[0].read_text())
    assert len(records) == 4
    for record in records:
        if record["old"]:
            assert (
                manifests[0].parent / record["old"]
            ).read_bytes() == transaction.ui_originals[Path(record["path"])]
    journal = json.loads((transaction.job / "transaction.json").read_text())
    assert journal["integrations"][0]["backup"] == str(manifests[0].parent)
    assert "Backup da integração" in result["message"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("write_number", [1, 2, 3, 4])
def test_ui_write_failure_rolls_back_entire_install(
    remote, nord_transaction, write_number
):
    original_apply = remote["NordDynamicPages"].apply

    def failing_apply(self, checkpoint):
        atomic = self.setup["atomic"]
        count = 0

        def failing_atomic(*args):
            nonlocal count
            count += 1
            atomic(*args)
            if count == write_number:
                raise OSError("injected after atomic replace")

        self.setup["atomic"] = failing_atomic
        return original_apply(self, checkpoint)

    remote["NordDynamicPages"].apply = failing_apply
    result = nord_transaction.run()
    assert not result["success"]
    assert not result["partial"], result
    assert_nord_restored(nord_transaction)
    assert not (nord_transaction.root / "config/workstation-manager").exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", ["presets", "restart", "final-ui-verification"])
def test_later_failure_reverts_ui_and_lv2(remote, nord_transaction, failure):
    restart = Mock()
    if failure == "presets":
        remote["discover_presets"].side_effect = RuntimeError("preset failure")
    elif failure == "restart":
        restart.side_effect = [TimeoutError("restart failure"), None]
    else:
        original = remote["NordDynamicPages"].verify
        count = 0

        def verify(self):
            nonlocal count
            count += 1
            if count == 2:
                raise ValueError("UI verification failed")
            return original(self)

        remote["NordDynamicPages"].verify = verify
    result = nord_transaction.run(restart=restart)
    assert not result["success"]
    assert not result["partial"], result
    assert_nord_restored(nord_transaction)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "case", ["unknown-host", "modified-hook", "foreign-module", "symlink"]
)
def test_incompatible_ui_is_refused_before_plugin_or_category_changes(
    remote, nord_transaction, case, tmp_path
):
    directory = nord_transaction.ui_directory
    if case == "unknown-host":
        path = directory / "zynthian_processor.py"
        path.write_text(
            path.read_text().replace(
                "def get_ctrl_screens(self):", "def unknown_ctrl_screens(self):"
            )
        )
    elif case == "modified-hook":
        path = directory / "zynthian_processor.py"
        path.write_text(path.read_text() + "\n# NORD view hook modified\n")
    elif case == "foreign-module":
        (directory / "nord_host.py").write_text(
            "# Nord managed controller integration v1\nCUSTOM=True\n"
        )
    else:
        (directory / "nord_host.py").symlink_to(tmp_path / "unrelated")
    before = {p: p.read_bytes() for p in directory.glob("*.py") if not p.is_symlink()}
    result = nord_transaction.run()
    assert not result["success"]
    assert not result["partial"], result
    assert not nord_transaction.nord_bundle.exists()
    for path, old in before.items():
        assert path.read_bytes() == old


def test_existing_integration_is_idempotent_and_not_removed_by_rollback(
    remote, nord_transaction
):
    transaction = nord_transaction
    first = remote["prepare_dynamic_pages"](
        transaction.spec, transaction.root, transaction.job
    )
    first.apply(lambda: None)
    before = {p: p.read_bytes() for p in transaction.ui_directory.glob("*.py")}
    existing_backups = list(
        (transaction.root / "config/workstation-manager/integration-backups").iterdir()
    )
    import shutil

    shutil.rmtree(transaction.job / "manager-ui-assets")
    result = transaction.run(restart=Mock(side_effect=[TimeoutError("service"), None]))
    assert not result["success"] and not result["partial"], result
    assert before == {p: p.read_bytes() for p in before}
    assert (
        list(
            (
                transaction.root / "config/workstation-manager/integration-backups"
            ).iterdir()
        )
        == existing_backups
    )


def test_concurrent_hook_edit_reports_partial_and_preserves_required_modules(
    remote, nord_transaction
):
    transaction = nord_transaction
    hook = transaction.ui_directory / "zynthian_processor.py"

    def external_edit():
        hook.write_text(hook.read_text() + "\nCUSTOM=True\n")
        raise RuntimeError("external change")

    result = transaction.run(restart=external_edit)
    assert not result["success"] and result["partial"]
    assert "CUSTOM=True" in hook.read_text()
    assert (transaction.ui_directory / "nord_host.py").exists()
    assert (transaction.ui_directory / "nord_pages.py").exists()
    assert "Hooks ainda referenciam" in result["message"]
    assert list(
        (transaction.root / "config/workstation-manager/integration-backups").glob(
            "*/manifest.json"
        )
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("metadata", ["layout", "catalog", "symbols"])
def test_dynamic_metadata_failure_prevents_any_live_mutation(
    remote, nord_transaction, metadata
):
    original = remote["NordDynamicPages"].validate_bundle

    def corrupt(self, bundle):
        if metadata == "layout":
            (bundle / "tools/control-layout.tsv").write_text("invalid")
        elif metadata == "catalog":
            (bundle / "catalog.nord").write_text("corrupt")
        else:
            (bundle / "tools/control-layout.tsv").write_text(
                "7\tx\tX\t0\tunknown_port\t0\n"
            )
        return original(self, bundle)

    remote["NordDynamicPages"].validate_bundle = corrupt
    result = nord_transaction.run()
    assert not result["success"] and not result["partial"], result
    assert_nord_restored(nord_transaction)


def test_original_upstream_modules_are_preserved(remote, nord_transaction):
    transaction = nord_transaction
    for name in ("nord_host.py", "nord_pages.py"):
        (transaction.ui_directory / name).write_bytes(
            (Path("tests/fixtures/nord-integration") / (name + ".txt")).read_bytes()
        )
    result = transaction.run()
    assert result["success"], result
    for name in ("nord_host.py", "nord_pages.py"):
        assert (transaction.ui_directory / name).read_bytes() == (
            Path("tests/fixtures/nord-integration") / (name + ".txt")
        ).read_bytes()


def test_install_command_compression_preserves_exact_audited_sources():
    import ast
    import base64
    import shlex
    import zlib

    from workstation_manager.infrastructure.installation import install_command

    spec = {"identity": {"repository": "zynthian-workstation/nord"}}
    command = install_command(spec, "/tmp/package", "/tmp/job")
    tree = ast.parse(shlex.split(command)[3])
    encoded = next(
        node.args[0].value
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
        and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
        and node.func.attr == "b64decode"
    )
    decoded = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(encoded)).decode()
    assert decoded == installation_source(spec, "/tmp/package", "/tmp/job")
    assert len(command.encode()) < 65536


def test_dynamic_rules_change_visible_controls_without_losing_values(
    remote, nord_transaction, monkeypatch
):
    import sys
    import types

    transaction = nord_transaction
    result = transaction.run()
    assert result["success"], result
    package = types.ModuleType("manager_nord_test")
    package.__path__ = []
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "manager_nord_test", package)
    pages = types.ModuleType("manager_nord_test.nord_pages")
    exec(
        compile(remote["NORD_UI_ASSETS"]["nord_pages.py"], "<pages>", "exec"),
        pages.__dict__,
    )
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, pages.__name__, pages)
    host = types.ModuleType("manager_nord_test.nord_host")
    host.__package__ = package.__name__
    exec(
        compile(remote["NORD_UI_ASSETS"]["nord_host.py"], "<host>", "exec"),
        host.__dict__,
    )
    document = transaction.nord_bundle / "state.ttl"
    document.write_text("fixture")
    host.host_context = lambda engine, uri: (
        transaction.nord_bundle,
        transaction.nord_bundle / "catalog.nord",
        document,
    )
    host.preset_identity = lambda uri, path: uri.rsplit(":", 1)[-1]
    controls = {
        name: types.SimpleNamespace(
            symbol=name, value=index, midi_binding=("keep", name)
        )
        for index, name in enumerate(("gain", "cutoff", "reverb"))
    }
    processor = types.SimpleNamespace(
        engine=types.SimpleNamespace(
            plugin_url="urn:nord:instrument",
            state_manager=types.SimpleNamespace(send_cuia=Mock()),
        ),
        ctrl_screens_dict={},
        current_screen_index=0,
        controllers_dict=controls,
        build_ctrl_screen=lambda names: [controls[name] for name in names],
    )
    original = dict(controls)
    for identity, expected in [
        ("piano", ["gain"]),
        ("sample", ["gain", "cutoff"]),
        ("pure", ["gain", "cutoff", "reverb"]),
    ]:
        host.preset_changed(processor, ["urn:preset:" + identity])
        screens = host.screens(processor)
        assert [
            control.symbol for page in screens.values() for control in page
        ] == expected
        for name, control in controls.items():
            assert control is original[name]
            assert control.midi_binding == ("keep", name)
            assert control.value == list(controls).index(name)
    processor.engine.plugin_url = "urn:other"
    before = processor.ctrl_screens_dict
    assert host.screens(processor) is before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("canonical", [False, True])
def test_real_lilv_metadata_validates_dynamic_layout_symbols(
    remote, tmp_path, canonical
):
    root = tmp_path / "zynthian"
    directory = root / "zynthian-ui/zyngine"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, fixture in [
        ("zynthian_engine_jalv.py", "jalv.txt"),
        ("zynthian_processor.py", "processor.txt"),
    ]:
        (directory / name).write_bytes(
            (Path("tests/fixtures/nord-integration") / fixture).read_bytes()
        )
    job = tmp_path / "job"
    job.mkdir()
    spec = dict(
        identity=dict(
            repository="zynthian-workstation/nord",
            plugin_uri="urn:nord:instrument",
            bundle="Nord.lv2",
        ),
        integration_components=["dynamic-parameter-pages"],
    )
    integration = remote["prepare_dynamic_pages"](spec, root, job)
    remote["URI"] = "urn:nord:instrument"
    bundle = tmp_path / "Nord.lv2"
    (bundle / "tools").mkdir(parents=True)
    (bundle / "manifest.ttl").write_text("""
@prefix lv2: <http://lv2plug.in/ns/lv2core#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
<urn:nord:instrument> a lv2:Plugin ; lv2:binary <test.so> ; rdfs:seeAlso <plugin.ttl> .
""")
    (bundle / "plugin.ttl").write_text("""
@prefix lv2: <http://lv2plug.in/ns/lv2core#> .
@prefix doap: <http://usefulinc.com/ns/doap#> .
<urn:nord:instrument> a lv2:InstrumentPlugin ; doap:name "Nord" ; lv2:binary <test.so> ;
lv2:port [ a lv2:InputPort, lv2:ControlPort ; lv2:index 0 ;
lv2:symbol "gain" ; lv2:name "Gain" ] .
""")
    (bundle / "test.so").write_bytes(b"\x7fELF" + bytes(60))
    (bundle / "catalog.nord").write_bytes(
        b"NORD-LIBRARY-2\0piano\0original\0name\0category\0display\0npno\0-\0"
    )
    layout = bundle / "tools/control-layout.tsv"
    if canonical:
        layout.write_bytes(
            Path("tests/fixtures/nord-integration/control-layout.tsv").read_bytes()
        )
        symbols = [line.split("\t")[4] for line in layout.read_text().splitlines()]
        assert len(symbols) == 125
        ports = ",\n".join(
            "[ a lv2:InputPort, lv2:ControlPort ; lv2:index "
            + str(index)
            + ' ; lv2:symbol "'
            + symbol
            + '" ; lv2:name "'
            + symbol
            + '" ]'
            for index, symbol in enumerate(symbols)
        )
        (bundle / "plugin.ttl").write_text(
            "@prefix lv2: <http://lv2plug.in/ns/lv2core#> .\n"
            "@prefix doap: <http://usefulinc.com/ns/doap#> .\n"
            '<urn:nord:instrument> a lv2:InstrumentPlugin ; doap:name "Nord" ; '
            "lv2:binary <test.so> ; lv2:port " + ports + " .\n"
        )
    else:
        layout.write_text("7\tgeneral\tGeneral\t0\tgain\t0\n")
    integration.validate_bundle(bundle)
    valid_layout = layout.read_text()
    for invalid_index in (-1, 4096):
        rows = valid_layout.splitlines()
        columns = rows[0].split("\t")
        columns[3] = str(invalid_index)
        rows[0] = "\t".join(columns)
        layout.write_text("\n".join(rows) + "\n")
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="controles reais"):
            integration.validate_bundle(bundle)
    layout.write_text("7\tgeneral\tGeneral\t0\tmissing\t0\n")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="controles reais"):
        integration.validate_bundle(bundle)


def test_release_without_internal_index_is_recorded(remote, transaction):
    result = transaction.run()
    assert result["success"], result
    bundle = transaction.root / "zynthian-plugins/lv2/Test.lv2"
    metadata = json.loads((bundle / "workstation-release.json").read_text())
    assert metadata["version"] == transaction.spec["version"]
    assert metadata["repository"] == transaction.spec["identity"]["repository"]
    assert metadata["provenance"]["asset_sha256"] == transaction.spec["sha256"]
    assert metadata["files"]["test.so"] == remote["package_digest"](bundle / "test.so")
    assert (
        remote["verify_package"](
            bundle,
            transaction.spec["identity"]["plugin_uri"],
            (bundle / "test.so").resolve(),
            [(bundle / "manifest.ttl").resolve()],
            "aarch64",
        )[0]
        == "1.0.0"
    )
    (bundle / "test.so").write_bytes(b"corrupted")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="checksum"):
        remote["verify_package"](
            bundle,
            transaction.spec["identity"]["plugin_uri"],
            (bundle / "test.so").resolve(),
            [],
            "aarch64",
        )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("content", [b"invalid json", b'{"version":"9.0.0"}'])
def test_existing_publisher_index_is_never_repaired(remote, tmp_path, content):
    bundle = tmp_path / "Test.lv2"
    bundle.mkdir()
    index = bundle / "workstation-release.json"
    index.write_bytes(content)
    remote["record_package_release"](bundle, {})
    assert index.read_bytes() == content


def test_generated_index_passes_real_lilv_inventory(remote, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    root = tmp_path / "zynthian"
    bundle = root / "zynthian-plugins/lv2/Test.lv2"
    bundle.mkdir(parents=True)
    (bundle / "manifest.ttl").write_text("""
@prefix lv2: <http://lv2plug.in/ns/lv2core#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
<urn:test:instrument> a lv2:Plugin ; lv2:binary <test.so> ;
rdfs:seeAlso <plugin.ttl> .
""")
    (bundle / "plugin.ttl").write_text("""
@prefix lv2: <http://lv2plug.in/ns/lv2core#> .
@prefix doap: <http://usefulinc.com/ns/doap#> .
<urn:test:instrument> a lv2:InstrumentPlugin ; doap:name "Test" ;
lv2:binary <test.so> .
""")
    (bundle / "test.so").write_bytes(b"\x7fELF" + bytes(60))
    spec = dict(
        identity=dict(
            repository="zynthian-workstation/test",
            plugin_uri="urn:test:instrument",
            bundle="Test.lv2",
        ),
        version="1.0.0",
        sha256="a" * 64,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(remote["platform"], "machine", lambda: "aarch64")
    remote["record_package_release"](bundle, spec)
    inventory = remote["inventory"](root)
    assert inventory["incomplete_bundles"] == []
    assert inventory["plugins"][0]["package_version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert inventory["plugins"][0]["uri"] == "urn:test:instrument"
    (bundle / "plugin.ttl").write_text((bundle / "plugin.ttl").read_text() + "\n")
    assert "Test.lv2" in remote["inventory"](root)["incomplete_bundles"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", [None, "restart", "after_write"])
def test_existing_valid_preset_cache_merged_transactionally(
    remote, transaction, failure
):
    cache = transaction.root / "config/jalv/presets_Test.json"
    cache.parent.mkdir()
    previous = {
        "User": {
            "bank_url": "urn:bank:user",
            "custom": "keep",
            "presets": [
                {"url": "urn:preset:user", "label": "My sound", "custom": [1, 2]}
            ],
        }
    }
    original = json.dumps(previous, indent=3).encode()
    cache.write_bytes(original)
    cache.chmod(0o640)
    remote["discover_presets"].return_value = (
        "Test",
        {
            "User": {
                "bank_url": "urn:bank:user",
                "presets": [
                    {"url": "urn:preset:user", "label": "Different label"},
                    {"url": "urn:preset:new", "label": "New sound"},
                ],
            }
        },
    )
    kwargs = {}
    if failure == "restart":
        kwargs["restart"] = Mock(side_effect=[RuntimeError("restart"), None])
    if failure == "after_write":
        atomic = remote["atomic_write"]
        failed = False

        def fail_after_write(path, *args):
            nonlocal failed
            atomic(path, *args)
            if path == cache and not failed:
                failed = True
                raise RuntimeError("after cache write")

        remote["atomic_write"] = fail_after_write
    result = transaction.run(**kwargs)
    if failure:
        assert not result["success"]
        assert not result["partial"], result
        assert cache.read_bytes() == original
    else:
        assert result["success"], result
        result_cache = json.loads(cache.read_text())
        assert result_cache["User"]["custom"] == "keep"
        assert result_cache["User"]["presets"][0] == previous["User"]["presets"][0]
        assert [p["url"] for p in result_cache["User"]["presets"]] == [
            "urn:preset:user",
            "urn:preset:new",
        ]
    assert cache.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o640


def test_unchanged_existing_cache_is_preserved_byte_for_byte(remote, transaction):
    cache = transaction.root / "config/jalv/presets_Test.json"
    cache.parent.mkdir()
    cache.write_bytes(b'{\n "User": {"bank_url": null, "presets": []}\n}\n')
    original = cache.read_bytes()
    result = transaction.run()
    assert result["success"], result
    assert cache.read_bytes() == original


def test_conflicting_bank_is_preserved_and_reported(remote, transaction):
    cache = transaction.root / "config/jalv/presets_Test.json"
    cache.parent.mkdir()
    cache.write_text('{"Bank":{"bank_url":"urn:old", "presets":[]}}')
    original = cache.read_bytes()
    remote["discover_presets"].return_value = (
        "Test",
        {"Bank": {"bank_url": "urn:other", "presets": []}},
    )
    result = transaction.run()
    assert not result["success"]
    assert not result["partial"], result
    assert "conflitante" in result["message"]
    assert cache.read_bytes() == original


def test_concurrent_cache_edit_preserved_on_rollback(remote, transaction):
    cache = transaction.root / "config/jalv/presets_Test.json"
    cache.parent.mkdir()
    cache.write_bytes(b"{}")
    remote["discover_presets"].return_value = (
        "Test",
        {"Bank": {"bank_url": None, "presets": []}},
    )

    def restart():
        cache.write_bytes(b'{"external":"preserve"}')
        raise RuntimeError("restart")

    result = transaction.run(restart=restart)
    assert not result["success"]
    assert result["partial"]
    assert cache.read_bytes() == b'{"external":"preserve"}'


@pytest.mark.parametrize("collision", [False, True])
def test_preset_discovery_rejects_other_engine_with_same_cache_name(
    remote, tmp_path, monkeypatch, collision
):
    import ast
    import sys

    plugin = Mock()
    plugin.get_name.return_value = "Nord"
    plugin.get_uri.return_value = "urn:nord:instrument"
    other = Mock()
    other.get_name.return_value = "Nord" if collision else "Other"
    other.get_uri.return_value = "urn:other"

    class Plugins(list):
        def get_by_uri(self, uri):
            return plugin

    world = Mock()
    world.get_all_plugins.return_value = Plugins([plugin, other])
    monkeypatch.setitem(
        sys.modules,
        "lilv",
        types.SimpleNamespace(World=lambda: world, Namespace=lambda *args: None),
    )
    source = """
def sanitize_fname(name):
    return name

def _generate_plugin_presets_cache(plugin):
    save_plugin_presets_cache(str(plugin.get_name()), {})
"""
    nodes = {node.name: node for node in ast.parse(source).body}
    remote["audit"] = lambda config: {"nodes": nodes}
    remote["URI"] = "urn:nord:instrument"
    if collision:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="conflita com outra engine"):
            remote["discover_presets"]({"engine_source": "fixture"}, tmp_path)
    else:
        assert remote["discover_presets"]({"engine_source": "fixture"}, tmp_path) == (
            "Nord",
            {},
        )
